groups.summary_note: Corrected public service details for the Northbank bridge closure, published for riders and customer information teams.

timeline.label: Advance notice
timeline.body: Post stop notices and publish digital travel guidance.

timeline.label: Closure begins
timeline.body: Detour signs active; replacement shuttles run every 10 minutes.

timeline.label: Mid-window check
timeline.body: Confirm stop conditions and refresh rider-facing service details.

timeline.label: Reopening target
timeline.body: Restore regular routing when bridge work is cleared and confirmed.

checklist: SERVICE FACTS
Route 12, the closure window, 8 closed stops, and 10 minutes shuttle headway match the corrected notice.
STOP MATRIX
All 8 stops and their signed shuttle boarding points are shown on the landscape matrix.
RIDER GUIDANCE
Detour instructions, travel-time guidance, and the rider communication timeline are published.
ACCESSIBILITY
Step-free boarding and 311 Transit Desk assistance are clearly stated for riders.
SIGNAGE AND ALERTS
Stop notices, boarding signs, onboard messages, and digital alerts are scheduled.
PUBLIC CONTACT
Every public-facing route to assistance points to 311 Transit Desk.
